prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized orca war-pod leader seen from the side, body in profile,
centered, in an aggressive forward-lunging posture. Flat app-icon
geometry. Body in a confident saturated dark palette color. Mouth
slightly agape with a few simple white triangular teeth showing. A
small bone-tusk relic (simplified elongated triangle) tied beside the
tall dorsal fin in a contrasting pale or bone-white palette color.
White eye-patch oval. Body posture is dynamic and menacing.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat vector app icon; modern UI icon register — bold filled shapes, sharp crisp edges, zero gradients, zero textures; centered single-subject composition on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; every shape readable at 16px

SUBJECT: adult orca in strict side profile, body in aggressive forward-lunging diagonal posture; sleek anatomically adult silhouette with tall dorsal fin; body filled in deep saturated blue-black (#000000 leaning into #0000FF for the main mass); mouth slightly agape revealing three to four flat white (#FFFFFF) triangular teeth as simple geometric shapes; a single white oval eye-patch (#FFFFFF) placed precisely at the head; one elongated bone-tusk relic — a simplified narrow triangle in pale bone-white (#FFFFFF) — tied flush beside the base of the tall dorsal fin as a flat secondary shape

CONTEXT: standalone app icon centered on off-white canvas; no scene, no background elements, no frame

COLOR: body in bold blue-black (#0000FF deep saturation massed with #000000); eye-patch and teeth in clean flat white (#FFFFFF); bone-tusk relic in flat white (#FFFFFF); strong contrast between dark body mass and white accent shapes

DETAILS: every edge sharp and deliberate vector geometry; flat filled shapes only; no brushwork, no gradients, no ink strokes, no textures; interior details rendered as secondary flat color shapes; dynamic diagonal body angle implies momentum and aggression; silhouette reads as a single bold closed shape at small sizes

CONSTRAINTS: adult anatomical proportions; no cartoon scaling; no juvenile features; no painterly rendering; no woodblock texture; no aging or wear
